description: This file defines the RepostItemValuation class and associated functions for handling item valuation reposting in an ERP system, including validation, status management, reposting logic, error handling, and scheduled execution.

classes.name: RepostItemValuation
classes.description: A Document class representing a stock item valuation reposting record, with methods for validation, status management, and reposting logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document, sets status, resets fields, and sets company.

methods.name: reset_field_values
methods.description: Resets item_code and warehouse if based_on is 'Transaction', and sets allow_negative_stock based on settings.

methods.name: set_company
methods.description: Sets the company attribute based on voucher or warehouse.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the repost record, optionally writing to database.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Enqueues the repost job if not in test mode.

methods.name: restart_reposting
methods.description: Resets repost status and internal counters for reprocessing.

methods.name: deduplicate_similar_repost
methods.description: Marks duplicate reposts as skipped based on item-warehouse-posting combination.
